fichas.title: Chimneys
fichas.summary: Overview of chimney functions, connection rules, cross-sections, fire protection, roof clearances, heights, and construction. The page illustrates chimney types, roof access, chimney tops, foundations, and ventilation-duct blocks.
uses: Carry flue gases from fireplaces and appliances to the open air above the roof

dimensions.label: Nominal heat output requiring an individual chimney
dimensions.context: Fireplaces above this nominal heat output must be connected to their own chimney; gas fires and appliances have a separate threshold.
dimensions.ocr_raw: each fireplace with a nominal heat output of more than 20 kW (for gas fires and appliances, more than 30 kW)

dimensions.label: Gas appliance nominal heat output requiring an individual chimney
dimensions.context: Gas fires and appliances above this nominal heat output must be connected to their own chimney.
dimensions.ocr_raw: for gas fires and appliances, more than 30 kW

dimensions.label: Building height requiring individual chimneys
dimensions.context: Each fireplace in buildings exceeding this number of full storeys must have its own chimney.
dimensions.ocr_raw: each fireplace in buildings of more than five full storeys

dimensions.label: Maximum fireplaces on a shared chimney
dimensions.context: Shared chimneys may connect up to this number of fireplaces for solid or liquid fuel, or gas.
dimensions.ocr_raw: Shared chimneys may connect up to three fireplaces

dimensions.label: Shared solid- or liquid-fuel fireplace nominal heating capacity
dimensions.context: Maximum nominal heating capacity stated for each fireplace connected to a shared chimney.
dimensions.ocr_raw: three fireplaces for solid or liquid fuel with a nominal heating capacity of up to 20 kW

dimensions.label: Shared gas fireplace nominal heating capacity
dimensions.context: Maximum nominal heating capacity stated for each gas fireplace connected to a shared chimney.
dimensions.ocr_raw: three gas fireplaces with nominal heating capacity of up to 30 kW

dimensions.label: Minimum cross-sectional area for shaped-brick chimneys
dimensions.context: Minimum clear cross-sectional area.
dimensions.ocr_raw: The minimum cross-sectional area for chimneys made of shaped bricks is 100 cm²

dimensions.label: Minimum side length for shaped-brick chimneys
dimensions.context: Minimum side length of the clear cross-section.
dimensions.ocr_raw: the minimum side length 10 cm

dimensions.label: Minimum cross-sectional area for masonry chimneys
dimensions.context: Minimum clear cross-sectional area for masonry chimneys.
dimensions.ocr_raw: for masonry chimneys 140 cm²

dimensions.label: Minimum side length for masonry chimneys
dimensions.context: Minimum side length of the clear cross-section for masonry chimneys.

dimensions.label: Maximum longer-to-shorter side ratio
dimensions.context: The longer side may not exceed 1.5 times the shorter side; expressed as a ratio, 1.5:1.
dimensions.ocr_raw: The longer side may not be more than 1.5 times the shorter.

dimensions.label: Chimney separation from combustible and flame-resistant materials
dimensions.context: Minimum separation of the external chimney surface from combustible and flame-resistant building materials.
dimensions.ocr_raw: The external surfaces of chimneys must be ≥5 cm from both combustible and flame-resistant building materials.

dimensions.label: Insulated gap for noncombustible materials
dimensions.context: Gap where noncombustible building materials are separated from the chimney instead of being in direct contact.
dimensions.ocr_raw: separated by a 2 cm wide insulated gap.

dimensions.label: Minimum chimney height
dimensions.context: Distance from fireplace level to chimney top; joint chimneys have a separate minimum.
dimensions.ocr_raw: The minimum height (distance from fireplace level to chimney top) is 4 m

dimensions.label: Minimum height for joint chimneys
dimensions.context: Distance from fireplace level to chimney top.
dimensions.ocr_raw: for joint chimneys 5 m

dimensions.label: Chimney top above highest roof point
dimensions.context: Minimum height above the highest point of roofs with a pitch of at least 20°.
dimensions.ocr_raw: Chimney tops must be ≥40 cm above the highest point of roofs with a pitch ≥20°

dimensions.label: Roof pitch threshold for chimney-top clearance
dimensions.context: For roofs at or above this pitch, the chimney top must be at least 40 cm above the highest roof point.
dimensions.ocr_raw: roofs with a pitch ≥20°

dimensions.label: Chimney-top clearance above other roof surfaces
dimensions.context: Height above other roof surfaces, as an alternative to the clearance specified for pitched roofs.
dimensions.ocr_raw: or 1.00 m from other roof surfaces.

dimensions.label: Chimney clearance above nearby roof structures
dimensions.context: Chimneys near roof structures must clear the structure by at least this amount; applies when the chimney is nearer than 1.5–3 times the structure height.
dimensions.ocr_raw: Chimneys which are nearer to roof structures than 1.5–3 times the height of the structure must clear the structure by ≥1 m.

dimensions.label: Proximity threshold relative to roof-structure height
dimensions.context: Distance threshold: the chimney is considered near a roof structure when nearer than 1.5–3 times its height. This is a printed range, not a descending range.
dimensions.ocr_raw: nearer to roof structures than 1.5–3 times the height of the structure

dimensions.label: Chimney top above perimeter parapet
dimensions.context: Minimum height above roofs with a perimeter parapet.
dimensions.ocr_raw: Chimney tops above roofs with a perimeter parapet must be ≥1 m above the parapet

dimensions.label: Maximum external chimney surface temperature
dimensions.context: Maximum permitted temperature of the chimney's external surface.
dimensions.ocr_raw: the temperature of the external surface may not exceed 100°C.

dimensions.label: Cleaning-opening dimensions
dimensions.context: Minimum stated cleaning-opening size; the printed notation gives paired dimensions, ≥10/18 cm.
dimensions.ocr_raw: Each chimney has a cleaning opening → ⑦ (≥10/18 cm, at least 20 cm below the lowest fireplace connection).

dimensions.label: Cleaning-opening second dimension
dimensions.context: Paired with the 10 cm dimension in the printed cleaning-opening notation.
dimensions.ocr_raw: Each chimney has a cleaning opening → ⑦ (≥10/18 cm, at least 20 cm below the lowest fireplace connection).

dimensions.label: Cleaning opening below lowest fireplace connection
dimensions.context: Minimum distance below the lowest fireplace connection.
dimensions.ocr_raw: at least 20 cm below the lowest fireplace connection

dimensions.label: Roof pitch requiring roof access provisions
dimensions.context: If the roof pitch exceeds this value, walkways, standing gratings, or steps are required.
dimensions.ocr_raw: If roof pitch > 15°, walkways, standing gratings or steps are required

dimensions.label: Roof access hatch dimensions
dimensions.context: First dimension in the access-hatch notation ≥42/52.
dimensions.ocr_raw: Access hatch ≥ 42/52

dimensions.label: Roof access hatch second dimension
dimensions.context: Second dimension in the access-hatch notation ≥42/52.
dimensions.ocr_raw: Access hatch ≥ 42/52
